RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel increases the risk of unconscious affinity bias, but it is not definitive proof of discrimination. For a lab directorship, broad leadership experience and formal management training may legitimately carry significant weight alongside or above technical degrees (PhD vs. Master's). 

Raising gender bias immediately can provoke defensiveness and close off productive communication. Instead, follow up professionally on your request for written feedback to understand the specific scoring criteria and rationale. 

If the explanation seems pretextual, or if hospital policy explicitly mandates gender-balanced interview panels, you should consult an employment attorney, union representative, or internal ombudsman to determine whether to challenge the process formally.
